searches.query: How long does a store hold a pickup order after sending the ready message?

chunks.text: Collecting an online order in a store  Store pickup has no delivery fee when the chosen store has the product available. Wait for the ready-for-collection message before travelling. An order confirmation is not a ready message. The store holds a ready order for five calendar days from the ready message. Contact the store if collection within that period is not possible; the published policy does not guarantee an extension.  Bring the collection reference and identification matching the collecting person registered on the order. A purchaser may nominate another adult in the order portal before collection. A forwarded email alone does not add that person to the collection record. Inspect large items at the store and ask staff for help with loading when needed.  Pickup eligibility and stock are specific to each store. The online product catalog does not establish which store has an item today. The published pickup process cannot answer a live stock question or reserve a product on its own. Product return and warranty windows start from the recorded collection date for a pickup order.

Store pickup may be available for an oversize item when the chosen store has stock. A catalog listing alone does not establish that a particular store has it. Do not carry a damaged or unstable load away from a pickup location.

When refunds arrive  The returns team normally inspects an ordinary parcel within five business days after warehouse receipt. Once the return is approved, the store submits the refund within two business days. A bank-card provider may then take another three to five business days to show the credit. These stages happen in sequence. A carrier delivery notification is not the same event as a completed inspection.  For planning, the longest published path is five business days for inspection, two for submission, and five for the card provider: up to 12 business days after warehouse receipt. That is a policy estimate, not a live payment-status lookup. Weekends and published holidays do not count as business days. A missing component or a dispute over condition can require further review.  Gift recipients receiving store credit are sent that credit after approval. The three-to-five-day bank-card processing period does not apply to issuing store credit. This page does not identify whether a particular return has been received, approved, or refunded.
